Speaker catalog: Sr. Director, Shared Platforms & Services, Levi Strauss & Co..

Jenny Patchen is Senior Director of Shared Platforms & Services at Levi Strauss & Co., where she leads the teams powering engineering excellence across Developer Velocity, Enterprise Integrations, Quality Engineering, Release Management, and Observability.

With 14 years of experience in retail technology, Jenny has built and led engineering and product teams across e-commerce, retail, and wholesale channels at Levi’s, and previously at Gap Inc., American Giant, and Timbuk2.
